data.name: Aimat
data.gender_notes: Aimat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who gives comfort and support. The name Aimat carries the meaning “Support, comfort” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aimat usually hope their child will grow to embody support, comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aimat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, comfort.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aimat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أيمت
in_arabic.meaning: أيمت تعني المرشد أو الدليل في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أيمت هو من الأسماء العربية التي تعني المرشد أو الدليل. يأتي من الجذر اللغوي 'أيم' والذي يدل على الإرشاد والتوجيه. في الثقافة الإسلامية، يعتبر اسم أيمت من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة وروحانية، حيث يرتبط بالإرشاد الإلهي والتوجيه نحو الطريق الصحيح. استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كاسم للمولود الجديد، حيث يأمل الأهل أن يكون لابنهم دور في إرشاد الآخرين.

in_urdu.name: ایمت
in_urdu.meaning: ایمت کا مطلب ہے مرشد یا رہنما
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایمت ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مرشد یا رہنما۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'أيم' سے ماخوذ ہے جو رہنمائی اور توجہ کا مطلب رکھتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، ایمت نام کو ایک ایسے شخص کے نام کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے جو دوسروں کی رہنمائی کرتا ہے اور انہیں صحیح راستے پر چلنے میں مدد کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ऐमत
in_hindi.meaning: ऐमत का अर्थ है मार्गदर्शक या नेता
in_hindi.long_meaning: ऐमत एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शक या नेता। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'أيم' से निकला है, जो मार्गदर्शन और निर्देशन को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, ऐमत नाम को एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के नाम के रूप में देखा जाता है जो दूसरों का मार्गदर्शन करता है और उन्हें सही रास्ते पर चलने में मदद करता है।

in_pashto.name: ایمت
in_pashto.meaning: ایمت د مرشد یا لارښود معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایمت د عربي نوم څخه دی چې د مرشد یا لارښود مطلب لري. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'أيم' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د لارښودۍ او توجيه په معنا دی. د افغان او پښتني دوديزۍ په منځ کې، ایمت نوم داسې يو شخص ته ورکول کيږي چې نورو ته لارښودي کوي او د هغوی د سمه لاره موندلو کې مرسته کوي.

in_english.name: Aimat
in_english.meaning: Aimat means Guide or Leader in English
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aimat is of Arabic origin, meaning Guide or Leader. It is derived from the Arabic root 'أيم', which signifies guidance and direction. In Islamic tradition, Aimat is considered a name that embodies the qualities of a guide or mentor, leading others towards the right path. Historically, this name has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person who provides wisdom and direction to others.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aimat" is derived from the Arabic word "A'imah," which means support or comfort. Culturally, an Aimat is considered a person who is not only caring and compassionate but also someone who provides strength and assistance. This name holds significance in various Islamic communities as it is often given to children who grow up to embody these honest and noble qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Aimat" takes on a deeper meaning. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "The most beloved of things to Allah are those which are beneficial to people." (Bukhari). An Aimat, therefore, represents the embodiment of benefit and positivity not only for those around him or her but also for the wider community. The name serves as a reminder of the importance of compassion, kindness, and support in our interactions with others, aligning with Islamic values and principles. Additionally, carrying the name of "Aimat" can inspire the person to constantly strive towards being a source of comfort and support for others, nurturing an inner sense of purpose and fulfillment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Support, comfort" symbolizes A person who gives comfort and support. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aimat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of support, comfort.
